convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load the AML (Adaptive Market Level) custom indicator, which requires the AML.mq5 indicator file to be present. The indicator implements fractal dimension-based adaptive smoothing, which must be reimplemented in Python since it's not a built-in MT5 indicator.

derived_values.name: R1 - normalized range over Fractal bars starting at bar
R2 - normalized range over Fractal bars starting at bar+Fractal
R3 - normalized range over 2*Fractal bars starting at bar
Smooth - EMA-smoothed price using adaptive alpha

params.direction_adjustment: subtract for buy, add for sell, multiplied by Point()
add for buy, subtract for sell, multiplied by Point()

other_exits: When use_opposite=true and opposite signal occurs, the existing position is closed and a new position in the opposite direction is opened

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When use_Multpl=false: fixed lots at Lots value. When use_Multpl=true: dynamic lot = Lots * AccountBalance / Max_drawdown, capped at SYMBOL_VOLUME_MAX

custom_logic_notes: Entry logic: Long when AML[1] >= open[1] AND AML[1] <= close[1] (AML is inside the bullish bar body). Short when AML[1] <= open[1] AND AML[1] >= close[1] (AML is inside the bearish bar body). All signal values are from the previous completed bar (index 1). SL/TP are set via a separate modify order after the initial market order, retried up to N_modify_sltp times with 1-second sleep between retries. The opposite signal logic: when a position exists and an opposite signal fires (with use_opposite=true), the current position is closed first, then a new position in the opposite direction is opened. The AML indicator uses a ring buffer (Recount_ArrayZeroPos) for its smoothed values and only updates the AML buffer when the change exceeds Lag*Lag*_Point, otherwise carries forward the previous value.
python_conversion_notes: The AML custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python. Key implementation details: (1) The AML indicator uses fractal dimension estimation (log2 ratio of range sums) to compute an adaptive EMA smoothing factor alpha. (2) It uses a ring buffer of size Lag+1 for the Smooth array, with Count[] tracking the circular buffer positions. (3) The AML value only updates when |Smooth[current] - Smooth[Lag_ago]| >= Lag*Lag*_Point, otherwise it holds the previous value. (4) The Range() helper function computes max(high) - min(low) over a count-length window starting at a given bar. (5) Entry signals use bar index 1 (previous completed bar), not bar 0. (6) SL/TP are in points (not pips) — SL=500*Point(), TP=3500*Point() — which for a 5-digit broker means SL=50 pips, TP=350 pips. No digit adjustment is performed; the EA uses Point() directly which auto-adjusts. (7) The SL/TP modification retry loop with Sleep(1000) should be omitted in Python backtesting — SL/TP should be set directly on the order. (8) Position is selected by Symbol() which means only one position per symbol (netting mode).
